source_text: Pater, si possibile est, transeat calix iste a me; verumtamen non sicut ego volo sed sicut tu. Suscipiens naturam carnis humanae omnes proprietates implevit ut non in phantasia carnem habuisse existimaretur sed in veritate. Proprium est omnis hominis fidelis primum nolle pati, maxime usque ad mortem; si autem voluerit Deus, acquiescere etiam contra voluntatem suam.
pass_a_gloss: Father, if possible it-is, let-pass cup this from me; yet not as I will but as you. Taking-up nature of flesh human all properties he-fulfilled so-that not in appearance flesh to-have-had he-would-be-thought but in truth. Proper it-is of every human faithful first to-be-unwilling to-suffer, especially unto death; if however God should-will, to-acquiesce even against will his-own.
pass_b_english: [[Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me; yet not as I will, but as you will >> Bible:Matthew 26:39]]. Taking human flesh’s nature he fulfilled all its properties so he would not be thought to have flesh only in appearance but in truth. It belongs to every faithful human first not to want to suffer, especially unto death; yet if God wills, to consent even against one’s own will. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
